description: Configuration drift events produced by Ansible audit jobs when observed device state differs from the golden model. Mirrors the repository's real drift artifact keys (host, vlans, switchports, acls, bindings). Audit jobs emit both a human-readable result and a structured JSON event; an external SIEM consumes the JSON for drift alerting. Enforcement behavior is unchanged: remediation only happens in enforce mode with a change ticket. External SIEM transmission is disabled by default.

configuration_object.description: Required. The configuration object that drifted, for example switchport_access_vlan or vlan_trunk.

correlation_id.description: Optional. Opaque identifier for joining the drift event with the audit job run.

device.description: Required. The network device where drift was observed, for example switch-access-01.example.

drift_detail.description: Optional. The secret-free drift summary mirroring the Ansible drift.json artifact. Each boolean is true when that resource category changed.

host.description: Inventory hostname of the audited device.

event_type.description: Required. Fixed value for this event family.

expected_state.description: Required. The state declared by the golden model.

message.description: Required. Human-readable summary. Must not contain secrets or private key material.

observed_state.description: Required. The state actually observed on the device.

previous_state.description: Optional. The last known good state before the drift was observed.

remediation.description: Required. Whether remediation was performed by the job that detected the drift.

severity.description: Required. Severity assigned at the source.

timestamp.description: Required. RFC3339 UTC timestamp of when the drift was detected.
